_comment: Archive-candidate tables for the sliding-window cold tier. Each entry drives PG DDL generation, archive-manifest output, and CI validation. Ordered by planned implementation phase.

candidates._comment: Phase 1 — append-only, immutable after creation. First workload; proves the full pipeline.

Phase 2 — first mutable transactional resource. cold_eligible_at is stamped at creation (no separate 'finalize the transaction' reducer exists — PosOrder is created directly in a terminal Paid state); archive_version is checked, not incremented, since no reducer mutates a row after creation today.
